recommendations.title: Immediate Relaunch of 'August Ads' Campaign
recommendations.detail: The account currently has 0 active campaigns. Relaunch immediately using the 'JULY ADS 2026' structure as a template, as it demonstrated a strong CTR of 4.33%. Set a daily budget aligned with previous spend levels to regain momentum and capture lead flow.

recommendations.title: CPM & Cost-Per-Message Optimization
recommendations.detail: Historical data shows an extremely high CPM of $355.78 and a Cost per Message of $87.28. To lower these, test broader targeting or Advantage+ Audience settings. The high CTR suggests the creative is relevant, but the bidding environment or narrow targeting is driving up costs.

recommendations.title: Creative Continuity and A/B Testing
recommendations.detail: Utilize the creative assets from the top-performing July campaign that achieved a 4.33% CTR. Introduce a secondary 'Limited Time Offer' or 'Monthly Special' creative to test against the control, aiming to maintain engagement while driving down the cost per click.

recommendations.title: Funnel Health Check
recommendations.detail: With 170 clicks resulting in only 16 messages (approx. 9.4% conversion rate), there is a significant drop-off. Review the Messenger 'Start' greeting and automated questions to ensure they are frictionless and encouraging for dealership leads.

alerts.message: Zero Active Campaigns: The account is currently dark with $0 spend and no active ads, resulting in a total loss of lead generation.
Critical CPM Levels: Historical data shows CPMs at $355.78, which is significantly higher than dealership benchmarks and is inflating the cost per lead.
Data Pipeline Status: Historical trends stopped abruptly on July 30. Ensure there are no billing issues or scheduled end-dates that prevented campaigns from rolling over into August.
